coverage_algorithm: Enumerate every persisted/transmitted artifact kind from actual writer, reader, protocol and adapter entrypoints
Map each kind exactly once to a family and exact immutable FormatContract
Compare extracted inventory with registered kind set; any difference blocks release
Resolve all exact decoders/extractors/checkers and required features
Attach a directed operation matrix, explicit refusal behavior and independently observed positive/negative cases for each advertised support entry
Check retained old projects/jobs/keys/evidence/recovery refs before retiring codecs
publication_gate: No INPUT_NOT_READY, unresolved contract refs, unregistered writer/reader or unsupported required operation may be advertised as a supported V1 release
finite_model_scope: W1/W2 small typed payload, S1/S2 cost profiles, T1/T2/T3 tools, bounded single-state protocol; does not instantiate all families
